cost.registered_gpu_hours_basis: the preregistration's section 6 figure, KC-E1's realized 0.9948 GPU-h at SIX slots times 1.2. This cell flies at FOUR slots under the owner's own GPU-order delegation, which does the same total work with less batching, so the sampler figure is reported against that ceiling under both conventions rather than blended or hidden

decides_nothing: This receipt reports ONE cell's flight. The comparator contrast, the other cell of the pair, the paired intervals and the preregistration's section 5 decision rule are separate acts under their own rows.

delivered_vs_comparator_operations.note: raw-space delivery is substitution-only; these are NORMALIZED counts, so a deletion or insertion delta is a normalization delta of a substituted span until the verdict attributes it. A move that cannot be attributed to a substituted span is a defect report, not a result

delivery_integrity.guard: for every window the delivered raw text carries the identical whitespace-token count as the sealed predecessor; a REFUSED window delivers the predecessor byte for byte and records zero applied substitutions; a DELIVERED window is byte-identical at every token position the repair did not substitute, so its differing positions equal that window's own recorded obs_repair_substituted_tokens, and it records substitutions if and only if a position moved. The refusal branch is checked FIRST: a substituted_fraction_above_ceiling refusal carries a WOULD-BE substituted-token count while applying nothing

legality.declaration_warning: GRANDFATHERED legality declaration: evidence-bearing arm 'fixed-legal-context' does not declare ['span_source', 'reference_source', 'legality_tier'] (docs/readiness/2026-08-15-legality-doctrine.md's either-field rule); this run's provenance tier is UNVERIFIED -- see the run manifest's 'legality' block

saturation.rule: a saturated or skipped pass-2 decode reaches core.repair_alignment as the empty string and is refused as empty_response, so it delivers pass 1 and can never contribute an empty span the way KC-E1's two saturated windows did

conec-entity-wer-official.definition_source: github.com/revdotcom/fstalign@69df0b2b357f994101d630cb3f56e22b57ebcf04 (Apache-2.0): src/wer.cpp RecordTagWer, src/wer.h WerResult, src/Nlp.cpp NlpFstLoader

monitor_summary.parked_definition: every slot idle AND nvidia-smi utilization.gpu < 5%

serving.monitor_summary_basis: core.session.serving.summarize_monitor_file over the attempt's own run wall window 1788852173-1788858523; core.driver.run_experiment_bundled writes no session-attach receipt (that is core.flight.FlightRuntime's artifact and this carrier's 90-second OBS tiling does not go through it), so head and tail idle count as parked against this flight rather than being hidden

throughput.realtime_factor_convention: metered cut audio seconds divided by the manifest's own nvidia-smi busy-time seconds -- the convention the KC-E1 and tail2s receipts use
throughput.slot_count_note: KC-E1 and the comparator flew at -np 6; this cell flies at -np 4, so a windows-per-minute comparison against them carries a serving change as well as a protocol one

token_match.basis: each cell's own COST record joined to its OBS record through the shared request id, so the count is the flight server's own, on the flight tokenizer, including the identical speech tokens of the identical audio
